data.title: Erin at Central Park
data.about:
Erin by Meraas offers premium residences and natural green settings in the heart of Dubai, challenging your perception of what it means to live in an urban jungle. The contemporary design concept of Central Park inspired Erin. Located in the vibrant City Walk neighborhood, the apartments offer stunning views of the lush park and Dubai skyline.

You can choose from one, two, three, or four-bedroom modern apartments. You will be able to participate in a variety of activities within your own private park. Aside from incredible dining options, world-class hotels, huge shopping malls, and excellent leisure and entertainment opportunities, you are surrounded by some of the city’s finest restaurants.

location_tile.title: Connected To Well-Established Road Networks And Highways
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
A strategic location between Al Wasl Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, Central Park at City Walk is connected to established highways and road networks, providing easy access to Dubai’s most popular attractions.

  • 01 min to city walk mall
  • 10 Mins to Jumeirah Beach
  • 15 mins Burj al Arab
  • 15 Mins to La mer Beach
  • 15 Mins to Dubai International Airport
